item.title: Automating Dify Knowledge Ingestion
item.description: This guide demonstrates how to automate document ingestion for a self-hosted Dify Knowledge Base using n8n. We build a stateless workflow that monitors Singapore HDB Town Design Guides, detects newly published PDFs, compares them against existing Dify documents, and automatically uploads new content through Dify’s Dataset API. The result is a self-maintaining RAG pipeline that keeps chatbot knowledge synchronized with authoritative source documents without manual intervention.

item.title: Building a Self-Hosted HDB Knowledge Chatbot with Dify
item.description: A practical walkthrough of building a self-hosted, knowledge-driven chatbot using Dify. This guide covers deploying Dify with Docker Compose, creating a Knowledge Base from HDB township planning documents, designing a conversational Chatflow, and exploring Kubernetes deployment options using community-supported Helm charts and manifests.
